subject: math
question: 计算 $n$ 阶行列式 $D = \left| \begin{array}{cccccc}1 & 2 & 3 & \cdots & n - 1 & n\\ x & 1 & 2 & \cdots & n - 2 & n - 1\\ x & x & 1 & \cdots & n - 3 & n - 2\\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots & \vdots \\ x & x & x & \cdots & 1 & 2\\ x & x & x & \cdots & x & 1 \end{array} \right|$
answer: D = (1 - x) ^ {n} + \left| \begin{array}{c c c c c c} - x & 0 & 0 & \dots & 0 & 1 \\ - 1 & - x & 0 & \dots & 0 & 1 \\ - 1 & - 1 & - x & \dots & 0 & 1 \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots & \vdots \\ - 1 & - 1 & - 1 & \dots & - x & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & \dots & 0 & x \end{array} \right| = (1 - x) ^ {n} + (- 1) ^ {n - 1} x ^ {n}.

steps.text: 分析 该行列式主对角线以下的元素都相同，可用上行减下行的方式使下三角的0元素增多，最后化为三角形行列式来计算.
从第1行开始，将下行乘以-1加到上一行，则
将第1个行列式按最后一列展开，第2个行列式的最后一列乘以-1加到其余各列，得

$$
D = (1 - x) ^ {n} + \left| \begin{array}{c c c c c c} - x & 0 & 0 & \dots & 0 & 1 \\ - 1 & - x & 0 & \dots & 0 & 1 \\ - 1 & - 1 & - x & \dots & 0 & 1 \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots & \vdots \\ - 1 & - 1 & - 1 & \dots & - x & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & \dots & 0 & x \end{array} \right| = (1 - x) ^ {n} + (- 1) ^ {n - 1} x ^ {n}.
$$

solution.final_answer: D = (1 - x) ^ {n} + \left| \begin{array}{c c c c c c} - x & 0 & 0 & \dots & 0 & 1 \\ - 1 & - x & 0 & \dots & 0 & 1 \\ - 1 & - 1 & - x & \dots & 0 & 1 \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots & \vdots \\ - 1 & - 1 & - 1 & \dots & - x & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & \dots & 0 & x \end{array} \right| = (1 - x) ^ {n} + (- 1) ^ {n - 1} x ^ {n}.
